## FAQ

- How do I get access? Open the Telegram bot (https://t.me/slavic_scally_bot?start=website), pick a payment method and pay there; access to the private channel comes through the same bot.
- Can I pay without a card? Yes: Telegram Stars or crypto (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, USDC, Monero and more).
- Can I see the videos before paying? Yes: free teasers cut from the full videos are on the Telegram teaser channel and on X.
- What if there are no new videos? A new full-length video drops almost every week; after more than 14 days without one, the subscription is extended by a week for free.
- Why Telegram and not Fansly? Telegram has the full, uncut versions at the lowest price ($19/month); other platforms require cut scenes.
